content.text: The scan found the entrypoints. The write will re-parse the tree with AST so the line numbers and hashes come from this snapshot.

argv:
import ast,hashlib,json,pathlib,zipfile
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace/source')
out=pathlib.Path('/output'); out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
kw=('observe','stop','publish','handoff','release','review')
mods=[]; locs=[]
for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
 if p.suffix not in {'.py','.c'} or 'incoming' in p.parts: continue
 b=p.read_bytes(); rel=p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
 mods.append({'path':rel,'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
 if p.suffix!='.py': continue
 t=ast.parse(b.decode())
 def walk(nodes, cls=None):
  for n in nodes:
   if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef,ast.ClassDef)):
    low=n.name.lower()
    q=n.name if cls is None else cls+'.'+n.name
    if n.name=='main' or any(k in low for k in kw):
     locs.append({'symbol':q,'file':rel,'line':n.lineno})
    if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef): walk(n.body, n.name)
   elif isinstance(n, ast.If):
    te=n.test
    if isinstance(te, ast.Compare) and any(isinstance(x, ast.Constant) and x.value=='__main__' for x in te.comparators):
     locs.append({'symbol':'__main__','file':rel,'line':n.lineno})
 walk(t.body)
ent=[x for x in locs if x['symbol'] in ('main','__main__')]
obj={'purpose':'Source navigation for the current tree. Not a release rebuild and not a security guarantee.','entrypoints':ent,'observer_publication_stop':[x for x in locs if x['symbol'] not in ('main','__main__')],'source_sha256':mods}
js=json.dumps(obj,indent=2)+'\n'
lines=['# Runtime source navigation','','Boundaries below are AST line numbers and SHA-256 of the current /workspace/source snapshot. This is a map, not a certification that stops, observers, or publication are complete or effective.','','## Entrypoints','']
for x in ent:
 lines.append(f"- {x['file']}:{x['line']} {x['symbol']}")
lines += ['','## Observer, publication, and stop symbols','']
for x in obj['observer_publication_stop']:
 lines.append(f"- {x['file']}:{x['line']} {x['symbol']}")
lines += ['','## How to read the boundaries','','Scripts with __main__ are process entries. main() is the function those guards call. AgentObserver.observe and SessionObserver.observe are content or session observation methods. review_candidate is the semantic alert check. judge_release and ScopeStop are release decisions. runtime_supervisor.observe is a supervisor function, separate from the agent observer.','','Hashes cover every .py and native/notify_launch.c in this snapshot. incoming/ is omitted. No archive was built and no behavior was executed.']
md='\n'.join(lines)+'\n'
assert len(js)+len(md)<6000, (len(js),len(md))
(out/'entrypoints.json').write_text(js)
(out/'README.md').write_text(md)
with zipfile.ZipFile(out/'source-navigation.zip','w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
 z.write(out/'entrypoints.json','entrypoints.json')
 z.write(out/'README.md','README.md')
for p in sorted(out.iterdir()):
 print(p.name, p.stat().st_size)
